issues.title_en: Why Fred Ssenoga believes Union can rewrite Uganda’s transport economy
issues.summary: SPECIAL BUSINESS REPORT By Brian Mugenyi KAMPALA — In a black office chair at Union Transport Alliance’s Luthen Towers headquarters, Fred Ssenoga sits surrounded by the very products that define his organization’s rapid expansion. The conversation moves quickly from transport to housing, consumer products, micro-financing, and digital payments.
